<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--bareos">Bareos</span>

Sets bandwidth.

## Synopsis

```text
setbandwidth [client=<client>] [fd=<fd>] [storage=<storage>] [sd=<sd>]
             [jobid=<jobid>[,...]] [job=<job>] [ujobid=<ujobid>]
             [state=<state>] [all] [limit=<limit>] [yes]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Limits the bandwidth of a File Daemon, a Storage Daemon or running jobs without changing the configuration. The Director connects to the daemon and sends the new limit in kB/s; it applies until the daemon restarts or the job ends. limit=0 removes the limit; a missing limit is asked for. NDMP storages cannot be limited.

job=, jobid=, ujobid=, all and state= select running jobs. For backup and restore the limit is applied through the File Daemon, for copy and migrate through the reading Storage Daemon. Without client, storage or a job selection the Director asks for the client.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `client=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  |  | Client name. |
| `fd=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  |  | Client name (as client=). |
| `storage=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name. |
| `sd=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name (as storage=). |
| `jobid=` | string |  |  | list | Job ID. |
| `job=` | resource | from [`.jobs`](../dot-jobs/) |  |  | Job name. |
| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Unique job name. |
| `state=` | string |  |  |  | Jobs in this state. |
| `all` | keyword |  |  |  | Every running job. |
| `limit=` | integer |  |  |  | KiB/s (0: unlimited). |
| `yes` | keyword |  |  |  | Do not ask. |

## Examples

Throttle the File Daemon to about 10 MB/s:

```text
setbandwidth limit=10000 client=bareos-fd
```

Slow down the running job 42:

```text
setbandwidth limit=5000 jobid=42
```

Remove the limit again:

```text
setbandwidth limit=0 client=bareos-fd
```
